newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - NEW YORK TIMES FRONT PAGE - AUG 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - NEW YORK TIMES FRONT PAGE - AUG 13.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Wednesday.
* The AFL-CIO said it would lend the Teamsters union $10 million a week to sustain its strike against United Percel Service, while UPS said strike-related losses would mean at least 15,000 layoffs.
* Israel and Palestine authorities agreed to report all they have learned about the recent Jerusalem market bombing to a panel that will include the CIA.
* The American Medical Association will allow its name to be used to endorse products made by Sunbeam.
* In Bosnia, political leaders are making millions of dollars smuggling goods into the territories under their control.
* House Speaker Newt Gingrich has spent virtually all of the $1.8 million in campaign money he has raised since January.
* Home prices are rising nearly everywhere for the first time in a decade.
* A new altitude warning system is being installed in hundreds of U.S. jets that may eventually be required on all airliners by the FAA.
